nodes.label: Pip
nodes.rationale: Prototype built at Hacktoberfest Hack Day San Diego, not a mobility aid: use it with a cane or guide dog, not instead of them. Guides mostly with taps and talks only when something changes (a turn, a door, an obstacle, arriving).

nodes.label: Clean code contract
nodes.rationale: Checked on this Mac only; there is no GitHub CI.

nodes.label: Cleanup contract
nodes.rationale: Delete what Claude made once it's replaced and unused, in the same task; never delete user/other-session work, trips/ or git history without asking; report deletions.

nodes.label: Comments explain why, not what
nodes.rationale: Tuning numbers get their unit and where the value came from.

nodes.label: Before-done checklist
nodes.rationale: check_code.py prints clean, check_design.py after UI changes, Xcode build after Swift changes, then graphify update.

nodes.label: Design-first rule
nodes.rationale: Any change to what the screen shows goes into the pen.dev design before the code.

nodes.label: Don't hide errors
nodes.rationale: catch/except must handle or log; empty catches only for cleanup allowed to fail.

nodes.label: graphify knowledge-graph contract
nodes.rationale: Query the graph before reading code; keep it current; big graph.json diffs are expected; tokens.json is skipped because 'tokens' looks like a secret.

nodes.label: Names say what things do
nodes.rationale: Short names only for app-wide S (state) and N (sensor data).

nodes.label: No dead code rule
nodes.rationale: Delete instead of commenting out; git keeps the old version.

nodes.label: No new dependencies without asking
nodes.rationale: Web app is plain JS with no build step/npm; tools/ stdlib only; iOS Apple frameworks only; server deps in requirements.txt.

nodes.label: Server deploy over Tailscale (tools/deploy.sh)
nodes.rationale: Stops every running copy of Pip on the 4090 PC (task, restart loop, APIs, both llama-servers, nothing else), restarts and warms models; keeps previous app.py as app.py.bak-<time>.

nodes.label: Sound and speech rules (frontend/app.js)
nodes.rationale: Sound and speech are not in the design; they follow research-based rules in app.js.

nodes.label: Testing contract: Mac vs phone
nodes.rationale: Screens, animations and layout are tested on the Mac via Xcode (iPhone or iOS Simulator); walking/navigation tests are the user's on the phone, no simulated walks or fake environments; diagnose from real trip recordings.

nodes.label: NSAllowsArbitraryLoads (App Transport Security off)
nodes.rationale: Lets the app talk plain HTTP to the model server on the local network.

nodes.label: Arrival check (room proof in 3 frames + vision model agrees)
nodes.norm_label: arrival check (room proof in 3 frames + vision model agrees)
nodes.rationale: A room counts only with detector proof in 3 frames in a row and the vision model agreeing you're inside, not looking in through a doorway.

nodes.label: Backtrack and retry (asks after 3 backtracks or 6 look-arounds)
nodes.norm_label: backtrack and retry (asks after 3 backtracks or 6 look-arounds)
nodes.rationale: Wrong room, all walls or circling sends it back to the long-term planner; after 3 backtracks or 6 look-arounds it asks the user.

nodes.label: Door coaching (vision reads door type, LiDAR detects it opening)
nodes.norm_label: door coaching (vision reads door type, lidar detects it opening)
nodes.rationale: Vision model reads the door once; LiDAR sees the door open because it suddenly sees past it. Glass fools LiDAR so glass/automatic doors keep the camera check; a door not opening after 45 s is skipped.

nodes.label: Getting out first (leave the building before the GPS route)
nodes.norm_label: getting out first (leave the building before the gps route)
nodes.rationale: Pip turns on GPS only when you name a place or say you're outside; from inside a building it walks you out first. Outside counts only when GPS has been good a few seconds and the camera agrees, because Wi-Fi location can look good indoors.

nodes.label: Long-term planner (where to go next)
nodes.rationale: Brain must pick a real candidate door/opening by id so it can't invent a door; progress judged only at decision points because numbers jump while walking; re-plans after every hop, asks after 10 hops.

nodes.label: All sound through native iOS audio
nodes.norm_label: all sound through native ios audio
nodes.rationale: If WebKit plays audio it switches the audio session to playback-only and the mic stops listening.

nodes.label: Short-term planner (A* path to taps and clock-face phrases)
nodes.norm_label: short-term planner (a* path to taps and clock-face phrases)

nodes.label: Directional tap guidance (ear-side taps that speed up as you face the target)
nodes.norm_label: directional tap guidance (ear-side taps that speed up as you face the target)
nodes.rationale: Pip talks only when something changes; taps carry the steady guidance.

nodes.label: Unknown places exploration (floor map doors, openings, signs, look around)
nodes.norm_label: unknown places exploration (floor map doors, openings, signs, look around)
nodes.rationale: A matching sign wins over a guess; without LiDAR, 8 photos during a slow turn are described by the vision model.
